name: 03-pin-examples
description: power_user.pin_examples = true with a budget that only one of the two groups can afford (openai.js:1337-1343): the dialogue examples are populated FIRST and spend the remaining tokens, so the history keeps only newMainChat -- the chat turn does not fit any more. assembly-07-examples-budget is the twin fixture, identical except for the flag, and there the history wins and the examples are dropped. That pair is what makes the switch observable: with a large budget both orders produce the same collection (the group order in the result follows the prompts' own indices either way).
